content_blocks.label: clause_1._TERM_AND_PREMISES
content_blocks.text: The term of the Lease shall commence on March 20, 2024, and terminate on March 19, 2027.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_RENT
content_blocks.text: Tenant shall pay Rent in the amount of $1,200 per month, due on the first day of each month.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._USE_OF_PREMISES
content_blocks.text: Premises shall be used solely for residential purposes and no part thereof shall be used for any illegal activity.
